paraphrase: Open premise, the fuller nominal definition: the name 'God' applies, in its proper sense, to the only being that is maximal in being (above all), causes the being of every other being (principle of all), causes every perfection of every other being (cause of every perfection, et hoc dicimus Deum), and enters into the composition of nothing (remote from all, q.13 a.8 ad 2). It keeps every condition the sources give, so it is weaker than STMT-GOD-NAMES-THE-UNIQUE-MAXIME-ENS.
